Enrichment moves 2026-10-06 (zcode:enrich-mytheme-l3), per scene:
#0 poems — the replay authored as motion: attract pointer at 0.4 (the invitation that draws the other back), auto-play, a sine LFO on circulation — the game's coming and going; the pawn's sequence resets it ♟ → inverted → ♟ (the board set up again); FT-P04's one breath walks 0·1 → All→none → 0·1 (the Two Ones, then the release of the All's finality). Duration 12.
#1 roads — THE 3D SCENE. z is the fork's divergence: the cancellation road receding (2→0 at z −0.4), the generation road near (4+2 at z +0.35), the P3 ring at middle depth playing itself apart through its rotation-and-shrink sequence — ring around the Rosie, falling down through the loop. Each road walks its own printed row; vortex + shove pointer (the fork refuses one road); depth perspective + occlusion. Duration 13.
#2 prose — grid layout: six images in cells that hold their seams (adjacency without identity — the record's own caution against turning emblem, operator and diagnosis into one evidence); repel + pulse pointer (each image keeps its own conditions); the cage/window sequence ▣ → ☐ → ▣☐ (enclose, admit, both need the frame); the broken token drifts together and brightens (recognition through fit); the taijitu walks ∵∴ → ∴ → unmarked (two dots, one dot, the erasure). Duration 12.
#3 black sun — attract + implode pointer at 0.6 (capture's intake); circulation −0.35 with auto-capture, a slow sine LFO — attention's drift toward a centre that does not answer; the four rings step inward Neptune → Jupiter → Mercury → corona (deepening red, shrinking); the radiating star's sequence ✷ dim → bright and larger (the alternative destination: outward as generative power). Duration 14 — the longest middle beat, capture takes time.
#4 return — ring layout: the return held in the round; attract pointer at 0.3 (the way back stays open); the shoe's ring returns smaller and paled (fit, then returned); Bimba's sequence C38 → pratibimba → C38 (the office occupied, the wider relation kept). Duration 15, the longest beat — the return takes its time.
ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: #0's checkmate that asks to be played again returns at #4 as the exact office of return — play beginning again, the six routes falling through their loop, the shoe fitting and being returned: each ending qualifying its work. The fork's two operations (#1: cancellation vs the 4+2 generation) return as the black sun's intake against the star's radiating circulation (#3): the same two fates of relation, first as arithmetic, then as social power; the pointer arcs from the player's invitation (0.4 attract) through the fork's shove and capture's implode to the return's gentle 0.3 — the way back to the particular words stays open.
Human-amplified staging: the kickers carry the flags exactly (#1's complementary lean, #3's adopted operations); the scene bodies state whose account where the record flags it. Mythemic verbs only: the poems and images demonstrate and perform their operations; no formal entailment, no independent arithmetic, history or calculus identity claimed.
Automation: auto-play (#0, field.params.circulation sine — the game's coming and going) and auto-capture (#3, field.params.circulation slow sine — attention's drift), both tied to the record's moves. Durations 12–15 and transitions 1.3–2.2: capture (14s) and return (15s) held longest.

glyph_rationales.checkmate — the king falls, and \"Anothe: The fallen king — FT-P01: the game reaches checkmate and asks to be played again; the ending opens what it had closed.
glyph_rationales.the husk — what comes back when knowing: The husk — FT-P02: the empty return when knowing fixes exclusively on its object; the conjugal relation of Known and Knower restores the act.
glyph_rationales.one, no-one, One — the knower spent into: FT-P03: it takes the One to know the One — knowing takes the separate claimant through no-one so that no-one, One, knows One.
glyph_rationales.the 0 is the One, the 1 is the All — non: FT-P04: the whole One at 0 and the enumerated All at 1 keep different offices; the All's claim to finality is released through none, once and for all.
glyph_rationales.the institution — made and making humani: FT-P07: humanity both made and makes the institution; one that consumes this continuing humanity devours its own constitution.
glyph_rationales.the fork of two — cancellation beside ge: FT-P11: both routes begin with two — opposed signed ones cancelling to zero, or 0/1 retained with the generating two.
glyph_rationales.the cancelling road — 2 to opposed ones,: The first road: 2 → (−1)+1 = 0 — relation resolved as opposed poles and cancelled.
glyph_rationales.the generating road — 0/1 kept, four pai: The second road: 2 → 0/1 → 00,01,10,11 + 0,1 = 4+2 — the four ordered pairings with the generating two kept alongside.
glyph_rationales.ring around the Rosie — six wrapped towa: FT-P14: differentiation playful and productive; love turns the six toward recollection while the ring is still forming.
glyph_rationales.falling down through the loop — completi: FT-P14's ending: completing the figure makes return possible rather than enthroning a finished enclosure.
glyph_rationales.the sealed frame against the open sky —: FT-P15: the mind that measures limits a sky, making a cloud where an aeon could fly; the open sky at the end answers the blocked frame.
glyph_rationales.the pointing word — the pauses making th: FT-P16: a word that points where no word can stand; the close turns an injunction to silence through three pauses, so, to, speak.
glyph_rationales.the fish — describing the water it lives: The fish: every distinction already sustained by the condition it tries to place before itself as an object; definition meets its condition from within.
glyph_rationales.the cage — the frame making its bounds t: The cage: a frame enclosing what it claims to show; the idol closes around what the frame was meant to disclose.
glyph_rationales.the window — the same frame admitting wh: The window: the same frame delimiting an opening; removing all determination would remove the window as well.
glyph_rationales.the kaleidoscope — a word as local orbit: The kaleidoscope: turning rearranges relations answerable to their object; a word a real local centre without being the final centre.
glyph_rationales.the Necker cube — reversal held by conte: The Necker cube: a face that receded comes forward; context holds the differently oriented readings in relation without becoming a fourth competitor.
glyph_rationales.centres without a final circumference —: Centres everywhere: each internality a centre whose world the other's appearance cannot exhaust; no enclosing last spectator.
glyph_rationales.the broken token — each kept half referr: The tessera: the break kept lets a relation be authenticated across absence; recognition later occurs through the halves' fit.
glyph_rationales.the erased dots — the outer form kept, t: The taijitu altered: erasing the retained others leaves the fields opposed while the capacity to retain the other has disappeared — arrogance beside annihilation.
glyph_rationales.the black sun — intake without an answer: The black sun: energy received at a centre without the circulation that renews the people and relations supplying it.
glyph_rationales.the radiating star — what reaches the ce: The radiating star: the changed destination of intake — what reaches the centre becomes available outward as generative power.
glyph_rationales.the corona — mutual exposure binding the: The innermost ring: compromising material binds participants through their capacity to expose one another; departure made costly.
glyph_rationales.the inner ring — Mercury's fixers, proxi: Mercury's ring: fixers mediating between power and its instruments in closest proximity.
glyph_rationales.the middle ring — capital's Jupiter grav: Jupiter's ring: the middle concentration of capital supplying stabilising gravity.
glyph_rationales.the outer ring — philanthropy at Neptune: Neptune's ring: outer philanthropy, the visible face of benevolence at the greatest distance.
glyph_rationales.cynicism, exhaustion, blankness — the fi: The attention sequence: cynicism still directs energy, exhaustion disengages, and the blank field leaves control deciding which questions become available.
glyph_rationales.the city — shelter and gathered energy,: The city: a plurality sheltered and its energy gathered; the maintained appearance of functioning cannot by itself establish that the constitutive relation remains free.
glyph_rationales.the king raised — play beginning again: The return of FT-P01: play begins again after checkmate; the ending qualifies the work rather than closing it.
glyph_rationales.the loop fallen through — the opening ke: The loop's fall kept: each ending qualifies its work — completion as the possibility of return, not enclosure.
glyph_rationales.the returned shoe — fitted, then given b: FT-P23: the shoe that fits must still be returned; a fixed claim risks becoming what has been fixed.
glyph_rationales.the four others — exceeding ground, diso: God as Other, shadow as other-self, friend as my-self's-other, alien/enemy as externalised uncertainty: distinct offices preventing one word Other from covering their difference.
glyph_rationales.the recursive Bimba — the local original: The recursive Bimba operation: a reference genuinely occupies a relative original's office while remaining pratibimba in a wider relation.
glyph_rationales.the particular words kept — each work ke: The compilation preserved complete: each work keeps its own words and opening, so a later relation can return to the particular utterance that made it possible.
